detail.abstract:
Abstract: HR Profession and the Prospective Role of Line Managers

Human Resource Management (HRM) plays an important role in improving employee performance and achieving organizational goals. In modern organizations, the responsibility of managing employees is not limited only to the HR department; line managers also play a significant role in handling day-to-day employee activities. This study focuses on the HR profession and the prospective role of line managers in areas such as recruitment, training, performance appraisal, motivation, communication, and employee relations.

Line managers act as a bridge between employees and top management. They help in implementing HR policies effectively and ensure smooth workflow within the organization. With changing business environments, digitalization, and increasing competition, the role of line managers has become more strategic and people-oriented. They are now expected to support employee development, maintain workplace discipline, and improve team productivity.

The study highlights the coordination between HR professionals and line managers for better organizational performance. It also explains the challenges faced by line managers while handling HR responsibilities and suggests ways to improve their effectiveness through proper training and communication. Overall, the research emphasizes that successful HR practices depend on the combined efforts of HR professionals and line managers.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了人力资源（HR）专业与直线管理者在招聘、培训、绩效评估、激励、沟通和员工关系等领域的协作关系，强调直线管理者作为员工与高层之间的桥梁，其角色正变得更加战略化和以人为本。研究指出，成功的HR实践依赖于HR专业人员与直线管理者的共同努力，同时分析了直线管理者在承担HR职责时面临的挑战，并提出通过培训和沟通提升其有效性。
AI.research_question: 直线管理者在人力资源管理中的预期角色是什么？HR专业人员与直线管理者如何协作以提升组织绩效？
AI.motivation: 现代组织中员工管理责任不再仅限于HR部门，直线管理者在日常员工活动中扮演重要角色。随着商业环境变化、数字化和竞争加剧，直线管理者的角色变得更加战略化和以人为本，因此有必要系统研究其角色及与HR的协作关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 角色理论（直线管理者作为桥梁角色）；战略人力资源管理理论（HR职能向业务伙伴转型）；协作治理理论（HR与直线管理者的协同分工）。
AI.method: 概念性/综述性研究，基于文献回顾和理论分析，未提及具体的实证研究方法或数据来源。
AI.findings: 直线管理者在招聘、培训、绩效评估、激励、沟通和员工关系等HR领域发挥重要作用；他们作为员工与高层管理之间的桥梁，有助于有效实施HR政策并确保组织工作流程顺畅；直线管理者面临的主要挑战包括缺乏HR专业技能和培训不足；改善其有效性的途径包括适当的培训和沟通。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统阐述了直线管理者在HR领域的预期角色边界，深化了对HR职能分工与协作机制的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了明确的方向：应加强对直线管理者的HR相关培训，建立有效的HR-直线管理者沟通机制，以提升整体人力资源管理效能和组织绩效。

title: Candor and the Algorithm: Deliberative Privilege and the Structural Vulnerability of Judicial AI

detail.title: Candor and the Algorithm: Deliberative Privilege and the Structural Vulnerability of Judicial AI

keywords: Model Code Of Judicial Conduct Rule 2.9

detail.abstract: In fiscal year 2025, the federal judiciary’s 677 district judges confronted 382,692 new filings, an average of 565 per judge, while carrying backlogs of approximately 800 pending matters each. With 40 Article III vacancies and no significant congressional expansion of the federal bench in decades, the structural labor shortage makes artificial intelligence (AI) adoption a practical necessity. A March 2026 Northwestern survey, the first random-sample study of federal judges and AI, found that more than 60 percent of responding judges use at least one AI tool in their judicial work, with 30 percent using AI for legal research. But the consumer AI platforms judges are most likely to use are generative AI systems prone to hallucination at rates between 69 and 88 percent on legal research tasks, and even retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems marketed as “hallucination-free” hallucinate between 17 and 33 percent of the time. Meanwhile, consumer platform terms of service authorize vendors to access, retain, and use judicial inputs for model improvement, compromising the deliberative privilege that protects pre-decisional judicial reasoning. This Article argues that the deliberative privilege extends to a judge’s AI research during the decisional process, but that this protection is structurally undermined when judges use personal consumer accounts. It applies the AI Legal Reference Model (ALRM) proposed in a companion article to the judicial context, identifies five doctrinal requirements any confidential judicial AI capability must satisfy under the ALRM, and predicts that the first subpoena to an AI vendor for a judge’s interaction logs is a foreseeable litigation event within eighteen months of publication. It further identifies the doctrinal protection gap: no current federal doctrine shields records of pre-decisional AI-assisted judicial analysis from compelled disclosure, and it proposes three legislative vehicles to close that gap before any institutional judicial AI capability can be safely deployed.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了联邦法官在案件积压严重、人手短缺的背景下使用AI工具的现实必要性，揭示了当前消费级AI平台存在高幻觉率（法律研究任务中高达69-88%）和隐私安全风险（服务条款允许供应商访问法官输入数据，危及审前特权）。文章论证了审前特权应延伸至法官的AI研究，但个人消费账户的使用结构性地破坏了这一保护。作者提出了司法AI应用的五项教义要求，并预测18个月内可能出现首例向AI供应商调取法官交互记录的传票，进而提出了三项立法建议以填补当前缺乏保护法官AI辅助分析记录的法律空白。
AI.research_question: 在联邦司法系统面临结构性人手短缺的背景下，法官使用消费级AI工具所带来的法律特权保护与数据安全问题如何解决？审前特权（deliberative privilege）是否应延伸至法官的AI辅助研究？
AI.motivation: 2025财年联邦法官人均面临565件新案件和约800件积压案件，结构性劳动力短缺使AI采用成为现实必要；但消费级AI平台存在高幻觉率且服务条款允许供应商获取法官输入数据，危及司法秘密性，而当前尚无联邦法律保护法官AI辅助分析记录免受强制披露。
AI.theoretical_framework: 审前特权（deliberative privilege）理论；AI法律参考模型（ALRM）
AI.method: 2026年3月西北大学首次随机抽样调查（联邦法官AI使用情况）；对消费级AI平台幻觉率的实证测试；法律教义分析
AI.findings: 1) 超60%受访法官在工作中使用AI工具，30%用于法律研究；2) 消费级生成式AI在法律研究任务中幻觉率高达69-88%；3) 宣称“无幻觉”的RAG系统仍有17-33%的幻觉率；4) 消费平台服务条款允许供应商访问、保留和使用法官输入数据；5) 审前特权应延伸至法官AI研究，但个人消费账户使用结构性地破坏了保护；6) 目前无联邦法律保护法官AI辅助分析记录不被强制披露。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将审前特权理论系统应用于法官AI使用场景，论证了该特权应延伸至法官在裁决过程中的AI研究；将ALRM模型应用于司法情境，识别出司法AI能力必须满足的五项教义要求。
AI.practical_contributions: 预测18个月内将出现首例向AI供应商调取法官交互记录的传票；提出三项立法建议以填补法律保护空白；为司法系统安全部署机构级AI能力提供教义框架和风险预警。

title: One Size Fails All? EU Insolvency Law between Harmonisation and 28th Regime
affiliations: University of Hamburg - Institute of Law and Economics

detail.title: One Size Fails All? EU Insolvency Law between Harmonisation and 28th Regime

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Corporate Governance Institute - Law Working Paper No. 924/20265
publicationDetails.journalName: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) - Law Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The European Union’s efforts to harmonise national insolvency laws have long been seen as a key step towards the completion of the Internal Market and, in particular, its Capital Markets Union project. Yet despite years of legislative activity, meaningful convergence has remained elusive. This article argues that the obstacles to insolvency harmonisation are not merely technical but structural: insolvency law reflects deeply rooted national choices concerning creditor protection, corporate governance, and economic policy. As long as economic conditions, market structure and business realities remain diverse across the EU, harmonising insolvency standards risks producing superficial convergence at best and counterproductive rigidity at worst.

Against this background, the article considers the idea of an optional ‘28th regime’ as a more flexible alternative. A supranational regime available for voluntary adoption could, in principle, combine legal certainty with respect for national diversity and allow for gradual learning through practice. Yet this approach, too, is plagued by design challenges and political constraints, and its success would depend heavily on its institutional detail. Rather than offering a simple solution, the 28th regime illustrates that EU insolvency integration requires experimentation, caution, and a recognition that one size cannot – and should not – fit all.

AI.tldr: 本文认为欧盟破产法协调面临结构性障碍，并提出“第28种制度”作为更灵活的替代方案，但强调欧盟破产一体化需要实验、谨慎，并承认“一刀切”不可行。
AI.research_question: 为什么欧盟破产法协调难以实现实质性趋同？以及在传统协调路径受阻的情况下，“第28种制度”作为可选替代方案是否可行？
AI.motivation: 尽管欧盟多年来致力于破产法的立法协调，但实质性趋同始终难以实现。本文旨在揭示其背后的结构性障碍，并探索更灵活的替代路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 破产法的制度经济学视角：破产法反映各国在债权人保护、公司治理和经济政策方面的深层制度选择，这些选择根植于各国的经济条件、市场结构和商业现实。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析，结合比较法与制度经济学视角的理论论证。
AI.findings: （1）破产法协调受阻的根本原因在于结构性差异，而非技术性问题；（2）强制性统一标准可能导致表面趋同或适得其反的刚性；（3）“第28种制度”虽提供了兼顾法律确定性与国家多样性的可能，但面临设计挑战和政治约束，其成功高度依赖制度细节。最终结论是破产一体化需要实验、谨慎，并承认“一刀切”不可行。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了破产法协调的结构性障碍，挑战了传统上认为通过技术性立法即可实现趋同的假设；为“第28种制度”理论提供了批判性分析，强调了制度设计细节的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 对欧盟立法者具有政策启示：建议欧盟在破产法一体化上采取更灵活、渐进和实验性的路径，避免强制性统一标准带来的负面效果。

title: Capital Readiness as Missing Infrastructure for Immigrant Entrepreneurs in the U.S.: Bridging the Gap Between Borrower Intent and Lender Expectations

detail.title: Capital Readiness as Missing Infrastructure for Immigrant Entrepreneurs in the U.S.: Bridging the Gap Between Borrower Intent and Lender Expectations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships that could have influenced this study. The author is the creator of PreCap Logic, which is briefly discussed in the paper as a practitioner-designed example of a capital readiness tool. This discussion is included for illustrative purposes only and does not involve paid promotion, external sponsorship, or third-party financial support.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper does not involve human subjects research, clinical data, or identifiable participant information. Practitioner examples are presented as anonymized composite observations based on professional experience and do not include direct client records or personally identifiable information. Therefore, formal ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Immigrant entrepreneurs play an important role in the U.S. small business ecosystem, but many enter the credit process before they are prepared for how lenders evaluate and price risk. Public discussion often frames the challenge as “access to capital,” with less attention to the preparatory work required to meet underwriting standards. This paper argues that an important missing piece is capital readiness: a practical, repeatable layer between a business owner’s need for funding and a lender’s requirements for documentation, repayment capacity, credit profile, operating history, and risk assessment.

Drawing on federal policy sources, small business credit research, CDFI practice, and field observations from work with underserved entrepreneurs, the paper examines the mismatch between borrower intent and lender expectations. Immigrant and underserved business owners often rely on personal savings, family support, credit cards, or informal funding sources, while formal lenders require clear evidence of repayment ability, organized financial records, and realistic uses of funds (Fairlie 2012; Federal Reserve Banks 2025).

Recent federal and local programs—including SSBCI Technical Assistance, the MBDA Capital Readiness Program, CDFI technical assistance, and local capital access initiatives—explicitly recognize that capital alone is not enough; entrepreneurs also need preparation, advising, and clearer pathways before applying for financing (U.S. Treasury 2023; MBDA 2024; Urban Institute 2021). The paper proposes capital readiness as a practical infrastructure layer that can help entrepreneurs understand lender logic, identify blockers, prepare documentation, and choose more realistic capital paths.

It also discusses PreCap Logic as one practitioner-designed example of a digital readiness tool that supports, rather than replaces, lenders, CDFIs, and advisors. The broader contribution is a practical framework for improving responsible access to capital among immigrant and underserved entrepreneurs in the United States.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"资本准备度"（capital readiness）概念，认为移民和弱势创业者融资难的关键不仅在于资本获取，更在于缺乏满足贷款机构承保标准的准备工作。文章基于联邦政策、小企业信贷研究、CDFI实践和实地观察，提出资本准备度作为连接创业者资金需求与贷款机构要求的中间层，并介绍了PreCap Logic这一数字工具作为实践案例。
AI.research_question: 移民及弱势创业者为何在正式融资过程中面临困难？如何通过"资本准备度"框架改善这一问题？
AI.motivation: 公共讨论多聚焦于"资本获取"问题，忽视了创业者满足贷款机构承保标准所需的准备工作，存在重要的认识缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本准备度（Capital Readiness）：作为创业者资金需求与贷款机构要求之间的实践性、可重复的中间层，涵盖文件准备、还款能力证明、信用档案、经营历史及风险评估等维度。
AI.method: 文献综述与实地观察：基于联邦政策文件、小企业信贷研究、社区发展金融机构（CDFI）实践，以及对弱势创业者工作的实地观察。
AI.findings: 移民和弱势创业者常依赖个人储蓄、家庭支持、信用卡或非正式融资渠道，而正式贷款机构要求明确的还款能力证据、规范的财务记录和合理的资金用途说明。近期联邦和地方项目已开始重视准备和技术援助，但系统性框架仍不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 正式提出"资本准备度"这一概念框架，弥补了现有文献中从"资本获取"到"贷款审批"之间的理论缺口，为理解移民和弱势创业者融资困境提供了新的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和实践者提供了可操作的框架，帮助设计数字工具（如PreCap Logic）和援助项目，改善移民及弱势创业者在美国获取负责任资本的路径。

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了毒物释放清单（TRI）如何通过信息影响企业行为，基于对七家大公司环境经理及其利益相关者的访谈和文献回顾，分析了企业动机模型和信息转化为行动的条件。
AI.research_question: TRI如何以及为何影响企业行为？信息如何转化为企业实际行动？
AI.motivation: 现有证据表明TRI会影响企业行为，但其作用机制和影响程度尚不明确，需要深入理解信息驱动企业变革的内在逻辑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业动机模型（包括合规动机、声誉动机、社会责任动机等）；信息-行动转化路径理论；利益相关者理论。
AI.method: 案例研究法（以TRI为案例）；半结构化访谈（七家大公司环境经理及利益相关者）；文献综述。
AI.findings: TRI通过多种机制影响企业行为，不同动机模型下信息转化为行动的条件各异，利益相关者的压力和企业内部管理决策是关键因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了信息透明机制（如TRI）影响企业行为的理论路径，完善了环境信息披露与企业行为关系的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计更有效的环境信息披露制度提供参考；帮助企业理解如何利用信息工具提升环境绩效。

title: A robust portfolio selection problem with price impacts in discrete time
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) - Department of Statistics, Xi'an Jiaotong University (XJTU) - School of Economics and Finance, Department of Mathematics, Statistics and Insurance, School of Decision Sciences, The Hang Seng University of Hong Kong  and The Chinese University of Hong Kong. Department of Statistics

detail.title: A robust portfolio selection problem with price impacts in discrete time
detail.abstract: In this paper, we solve a robust portfolio choice problem of an investor with stochastic factors and price impacts in discrete time. Trading incurs both permanent and temporary price impacts and the investor exhibits ambiguity aversion toward the model estimation errors of the asset return and stochastic factor processes. The robust portfolio choice problem is formulated such that the investor aims to maximize the local mean-variance preference on his investment returns and the mark-to-market profits & losses due to price impacts, netting execution costs and penalized by the model estimation errors. Different from the case with temporary price impact only, we show that the investor may not always trade toward the so-called aim portfolio. Compared with the non-robust case, the ambiguityaverse investor adopts a more conservative trading strategy; while the investor tends to trade toward the assets with higher permanent price impacts or lower market resilience rates, with the trading speed constrained by the magnitude of his ambiguity aversion. Our simulation studies indicate that the robust trading strategy generally performs better than the non-robust one, and mark-to-market profits & losses due to permanent price impacts can result in the net Sharpe ratio to be higher than the gross Sharpe ratio.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了离散时间下具有随机因子和价格冲击的稳健投资组合选择问题，发现投资者在存在永久性价格冲击时可能不会始终向目标组合交易，且模糊厌恶导致更保守的交易策略，但稳健策略表现优于非稳健策略。
AI.research_question: 在具有随机因子和价格冲击的离散时间环境下，模糊厌恶投资者如何做出稳健的投资组合选择？
AI.motivation: 现有文献多假设投资者完全信任模型，但实际中存在模型估计误差；同时已有研究多考虑临时价格冲击，较少同时考虑永久性价格冲击和模糊厌恶的交互影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 稳健控制理论（模糊厌恶）、局部均值-方差偏好、永久性与临时性价格冲击模型、随机因子模型。
AI.method: 理论推导与数值模拟，构建离散时间下的稳健投资组合优化模型，求解投资者在模糊厌恶下的最优交易策略。
AI.findings: （1）与仅考虑临时价格冲击不同，存在永久性价格冲击时投资者不一定始终向目标组合交易；（2）模糊厌恶投资者采取更保守的策略；（3）投资者倾向于交易永久性价格冲击较高或市场恢复率较低的资产，交易速度受模糊厌恶程度约束；（4）稳健策略优于非稳健策略；（5）永久性价格冲击导致的盯市盈亏可使净夏普比率高于总夏普比率。
AI.theory_contributions: 将模糊厌恶与永久性+临时性价格冲击结合起来分析，拓展了稳健投资组合选择理论，揭示了永久性价格冲击下"向目标组合交易"结论的局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为模糊厌恶投资者在存在市场摩擦（价格冲击）时提供更优的交易策略参考，有助于理解永久性价格冲击对夏普比率的影响。

title: Black-Box Stewardship: AI-Assisted Proxy Voting and Fiduciary Duty
affiliations: University of South Carolina - Darla Moore School of Business

detail.title: Black-Box Stewardship: AI-Assisted Proxy Voting and Fiduciary Duty
detail.abstract:
Artificial intelligence (AI) is beginning to participate in producing the judgment for which fiduciaries are legally responsible. This Article examines that problem in the setting of registered investment advisers' proxy voting under Rule 206(4)-6 and the Advisers Act's fiduciary standard. AI-assisted proxy voting is not merely a new technological tool; in some configurations, AI can gather information, apply voting policies, generate recommendations, explain those recommendations, or cause votes to be cast without individualized human review. The central question is therefore not whether advisers may use AI, but when AI-assisted reliance becomes AI-driven substitution. 
The duties that govern that question are familiar: care, loyalty, retained responsibility, and the recordkeeping and compliance architecture that makes voting decisions reviewable. What AI changes is not the content of those duties but the operational account of how they are satisfied when part of the analytic process has moved into a computational system. 
The Article makes three principal contributions. First, it identifies the fiduciary principle that AI places under pressure: a fiduciary may rely on outside inputs but may not substitute those inputs for its own judgment. Second, it reconceives reviewability as reconstructability, recasting the inquiry from whether the adviser can inspect a model's internal reasoning to whether it can reconstruct the inputs, instructions, policy, output, human review, conflict controls, and records that produced the vote. Third, it offers a four-mode typology of AI use in proxy voting: research assistant, policy-execution tool, recommendation engine, and autonomous or default voter. The typology maps increasing AI participation in voting judgment onto increasingly demanding fiduciary controls. Together, these contributions yield a framework, organized around ex-ante governance, use-stage controls, and ongoing monitoring, for determining when AI-assisted voting remains consistent with fiduciary judgment.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了注册投资顾问在代理投票中使用AI时，如何区分"AI辅助"与"AI替代"，并提出了一个 fiduciary 框架来确保AI使用不违反受托人责任。
AI.research_question: 当AI参与受托人负有法律责任的判断过程时，如何区分AI辅助与AI替代？受托人应如何确保AI-assisted proxy voting符合 fiduciary 标准？
AI.motivation: AI正在进入受托人负有法律责任的判断领域，传统 fiduciary 标准面临挑战。核心问题不是能否使用AI，而是何时AI辅助会变成AI替代，从而违反 fiduciary duty。
AI.theoretical_framework: fiduciary duties（注意义务、忠实义务、保留责任），以及记录保存与合规架构。AI不改变这些义务的内容，但改变了这些义务如何被履行的操作方式。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析，结合 Rule 206(4)-6 和 Advisers Act 的 fiduciary 标准，构建类型学框架。
AI.findings: 1）AI施压的核心 fiduciary 原则：受托人可以依赖外部输入，但不能用外部输入替代自己的判断。2）将"可审查性"重新概念化为"可重构性"——关注能否重构投票产生的完整过程。3）提出AI使用的四种模式：研究助手、政策执行工具、推荐引擎、自主或默认投票者，AI参与程度越高，fiduciary 控制要求越严格。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"可重构性"替代"可审查性"的理论框架，以及AI参与fiduciary判断的四模式类型学，为区分AI辅助与AI替代提供了理论标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 为注册投资顾问提供了一个围绕"事前治理—使用阶段控制—持续监控"的组织框架，帮助确定AI辅助投票何时与 fiduciary judgment 一致。

AI.research_question: 人类看似对立的行为（如利他vs侵害、奉献vs防御）是否源于同一套统一的行为动力学机制？
AI.motivation: 心理学中许多对立行为通常被视为不同的机制，作者试图用一个统一框架来解释这些现象，从而简化对人类行为的理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 统一行为动力学模型（BDM），包含SEMAT（行为启动与相变）等子机制，基于动力学系统和参数空间理论。
AI.method: 理论建模与整合，提出统一的行为动力学模型框架。
AI.findings: 利他主义与侵害、奉献与防御、爆发与冻结等对立行为是同一套机制在不同参数空间区域下的不同表现。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了统一行为动力学模型（BDM），将多个看似对立的心理学机制整合到一个统一的动力学框架下，为理解人类行为提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为预测和干预人类行为（如从利他转向侵害、从奉献转向防御）提供了理论基础，有助于理解行为转变的条件。

title: GENDER DISPARITIES IN LITERACY AND WORKFORCE PARTICIPATIONS IN INDIA

detail.title: GENDER DISPARITIES IN LITERACY AND WORKFORCE PARTICIPATIONS IN INDIA

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest exists
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not relevant for the paper

detail.abstract: Objectives This study aims to examine the trends and patterns of gender gaps in Literacy Rates and Workforce Participation rates and the inter-linkages between these two across Indian states/UTs. Design/ Methodology/approach Utilizing Census data from 1971 to 2011, the study measures spatio-temporal patterns of the gender gaps and gender disparity indices using Kundu and Rao Framework (1986) across the Indian states/UTs. Moreover, the study examines the interlinkages between gender gaps in Literacy rates and Workforce Participation Rates using Random Effect Panel Regression model. To examine the nature of association between the gender gaps in Literacy Rates and Workforce Participation Rates, Panel regression models are estimated to explain possible variations in the two variables, with the help of selected explanatory variables. This paper uses Sex Ratio (SR), Per Capita Net State Domestic Product (PCNSDP), Female to Male Population Growth Ratio (FMPGR), Percentage of SC Population (SC), Percentage of ST Population (ST), Urbanization (URB), State wise Human Development Index (HDI) and Percentage of People below Poverty Line (BPL) as possible explanatory variables. Findings The results provide evidence that despite a massive improvement in the Female Literacy and Workforce Participations, still there is a very high gender gap across the Indian states/UTs. The empirical findings reported that gender gaps in Literacy Rates have a negative impact on gender gap in Workforce Participation Rates with 0.503 coefficient value at 1 percent level. Similarly, gender gap in Workforce Participation Rates also have a negative impact on gender gap in Literacy Rates with 0.721 coefficient value at 1 percent level.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用1971-2011年印度人口普查数据，分析印度各邦/中央直辖区在识字率和劳动力参与率方面的性别差距趋势及两者之间的相互关系，发现尽管女性识字率和劳动力参与率大幅提升，但性别差距依然显著，且两者之间存在负向相互影响。
AI.research_question: 印度各邦/中央直辖区的识字率性别差距与劳动力参与率性别差距之间有何种相互关联？
AI.motivation: 印度虽然经济发展有所进步，但性别不平等问题依然突出，尤其是在识字率和劳动力参与方面。现有研究缺乏对这两类性别差距之间相互关系的系统考察，因此本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: Kundu and Rao Framework (1986) 用于测度时空格局和性别差距指数；随机效应面板回归模型用于分析变量间的相互关联。
AI.method: 使用1971-2011年印度人口普查数据，采用Kundu和Rao框架衡量性别差距和性别差异指数；运用随机效应面板回归模型，以识字率性别差距和劳动力参与率性别差距为因变量，相互做回归分析，并纳入性别比、人均净国家国内生产总值、女性/男性人口增长比、表列种姓比例、表列部落比例、城市化率、邦级人类发展指数、贫困线以下人口比例作为解释变量。
AI.findings: (1) 尽管女性识字率和劳动力参与率大幅提升，但印度各邦性别差距仍然很高；(2) 识字率性别差距对劳动力参与率性别差距有显著负向影响（系数0.503，1%水平显著）；(3) 劳动力参与率性别差距对识字率性别差距也有显著负向影响（系数0.721，1%水平显著）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统考察了印度各邦识字率性别差距与劳动力参与率性别差距之间的双向负向因果关系，拓展了性别不平等研究的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度政策制定者提供了实证依据：缩小识字率性别差距有助于缩小劳动力参与率性别差距，反之亦然，暗示政策应同时关注教育和就业两个领域的性别平等，形成协同效应。

title: AI-based Demand Forecasting in Retail Stores using Data Analysis

detail.title: AI-based Demand Forecasting in Retail Stores using Data Analysis
detail.abstract: This research paper focuses on analysing production and sensor data to understand patterns and support demand forecasting in retail environments. In today's competitive business world, accurate demand forecasting plays a vital role in managing inventory, reducing operational costs, and improving customer satisfaction. With the advancement of data analytics and Artificial Intelligence (AI), organizations are increasingly relying on data-driven approaches to make better decisions. In this study, Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) techniques are applied to a dataset containing timebased sensor readings and production-related variables. The analysis involves examining trends, variations, and relationships among different parameters to identify meaningful insights. Various aspects such as time-based behaviour, fluctuations in sensor values, and overall data distribution are studied in detail. The objective of this research is to utilize data analysis techniques to improve forecasting accuracy and support efficient decision-making in retail operations. By identifying hidden patterns and trends in the dataset, this study helps in understanding how production data can influence demand forecasting. The findings of this research provide valuable insights that can help businesses optimize inventory management, reduce waste, and enhance operational efficiency. Overall, this study highlights the importance of data analytics in modern retail environments and demonstrates how data-driven techniques can contribute to improved business performance and strategic planning.

AI.tldr: 本文通过探索性数据分析（EDA）技术分析零售环境中的生产数据和传感器读数，以识别隐藏模式，支持需求预测，从而优化库存管理、降低运营成本并提高客户满意度。
AI.research_question: 如何利用生产数据和传感器读数的探索性数据分析来改善零售环境中的需求预测准确性？
AI.motivation: 在竞争激烈的商业环境中，准确的需求预测对库存管理、成本降低和客户满意度至关重要；随着数据分析和人工智能的发展，组织越来越依赖数据驱动的方法来优化决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 探索性数据分析（EDA）、时间序列分析、数据驱动的需求预测理论
AI.method: 对包含时间序列传感器读数和生产相关变量的数据集应用探索性数据分析（EDA）技术，分析趋势、变异性和参数间的关系。
AI.findings: 通过识别数据中的隐藏模式和趋势，揭示了生产数据如何影响需求预测，为企业优化库存管理、减少浪费和提高运营效率提供了有价值的见解。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了EDA技术在零售需求预测场景中的应用价值，丰富了数据驱动的零售运营决策理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助企业优化库存管理、降低运营成本、减少浪费、提高客户满意度和运营效率，为零售战略规划提供数据支持。

title: Strategic Models of Technology Adoption and Performance in Public Service Organizations: A Multi-Level Analysis of Employee Behavior and Institutional Outcomes
affiliations: Institute of Management and Technology (IMT), Enugu

detail.title: Strategic Models of Technology Adoption and Performance in Public Service Organizations: A Multi-Level Analysis of Employee Behavior and Institutional Outcomes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No personal or financial relationship with other people or organizations that may have or could be perceived to have influenced the study
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involved the collection of primary data through structured questionnaires/interviews, conducted with participants who were clearly informed about the objectives and purpose of the research. Participation was entirely voluntary, and informed consent was obtained from all respondents prior to their involvement in the study. Respondents were assured of the confidentiality and anonymity of their responses, and all data collected were handled with strict adherence to ethical standards. The study complied with relevant institutional and ethical guidelines for research involving human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: Self

detail.abstract: Globally, public service companies are undergoing a transformation due to the rapid use of digital technology, which is changing employee performance, operational efficiency, and service delivery systems. Using a multilevel analytical approach that incorporates organizational and individual viewpoints, this study investigates the relationship between technology adoption, employee behavior, and institutional performance. The study creates nine interconnected models based on the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) and the Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT) to assess how employee productivity, adaptive performance, and innovative work behavior are influenced by perceived ease of use, perceived usefulness, behavioral intention, social influence, and facilitating conditions. In order to evaluate the behavioral and institutional aspects of technology adoption, a descriptive research approach was used that combined quantitative methods with strategic analytical tools including regression analysis, SWOT, and PESTEL frameworks. The research also looks at how stakeholder collaboration, operational efficiency, service delivery effectiveness, strategy alignment, and technical limitations affect public sector performance at the organizational level. The findings demonstrate that using technology in accordance with institutional norms and governance frameworks significantly enhances employee performance and accelerates business operations. The greatest outcomes, however, are nevertheless hampered by persistent issues including inadequate infrastructure, a lack of digital skills, disjointed legislation, and cybersecurity risks. The research recommends a number of specific policy measures, including increased investment in digital infrastructure, continuous worker capacity training, regulatory harmonization, and enhanced cybersecurity governance. By combining factual data with strategic insights, this study provides a strong basis for advancing digital transformation and improving performance in public sector companies around the globe.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于TAM和UTAUT理论，通过多层次分析方法探讨公共部门企业技术采纳、员工行为与组织绩效之间的关系。研究发现技术采纳能提升员工绩效和运营效率，但基础设施不足、数字技能缺乏、法规碎片化和网络安全风险仍是主要障碍。
AI.research_question: 技术采纳、员工行为与公共部门企业机构绩效之间存在怎样的关系？
AI.motivation: 全球公共服务业正经历数字化转型，但关于技术采纳如何通过员工行为影响组织绩效的多层次研究尚不充分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术接受模型（TAM）和整合型技术接受与使用理论（UTAUT）
AI.method: 描述性研究方法，结合定量方法（回归分析）与战略分析工具（SWOT、PESTEL框架），构建九个互联模型的多层次分析。
AI.findings: 技术采纳符合制度规范和治理框架能显著提升员工绩效和加速业务运营，但基础设施不足、数字技能缺乏、法规碎片化和网络安全风险仍是主要挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 将TAM和UTAUT扩展到公共部门语境，构建了组织与个体双重视角的多层次分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出增加数字基础设施投资、持续员工能力培训、法规协调统一和加强网络安全治理等具体政策建议。

title: SEMAT: The Behavioral Initiation and Phase Transition Mechanism -The Atomic

detail.title: SEMAT: The Behavioral Initiation and Phase Transition Mechanism -The Atomic
detail.abstract: How does the "first time" of a behavior occur? What is the psychological mechanism at the critical point from "not doing" to "doing"? From everyday altruism to heroic sacrifice, from lying flat to rushing into a crowd with a gasoline canister-do these seemingly disparate behaviors share the same initiation logic?

AI.tldr: 这篇论文探讨了行为"第一次"发生的心理机制，研究从"不做"到"做"的临界点心理过程，并提出不同行为（从日常利他到英雄牺牲，从躺平到持汽油罐冲进人群）可能共享相同的启动逻辑。
AI.research_question: 行为的"第一次"是如何发生的？从"不做"到"做"的临界点存在怎样的心理机制？看似截然不同的行为（日常利他与英雄牺牲、躺平与极端行为）是否共享相同的启动逻辑？
AI.motivation: 理解行为发生的"第一次"这一普遍但尚未被充分解释的心理现象，探究不同行为在启动时刻是否存在共通的心理机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为启动心理机制理论；临界点转变理论；行为连续性/非连续性理论
AI.method: 理论分析与概念整合（基于对多种行为类型的抽象概括）
AI.findings: 从日常利他到英雄牺牲、从躺平到极端行为，这些看似不同的行为可能共享相同的"第一次"启动逻辑，存在共通的心理机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出行为"第一次"的统一心理解释框架，连接了日常行为与极端行为的启动机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 有助于理解行为改变的临界点，对行为干预、道德教育、极端行为预防等具有启示意义。

detail.abstract: This study focuses on the retail export potential of Kolhapuri Chappals, a traditional GI-tagged leather footwear product from Kolhapur district, Maharashtra, under the Government of India’s One District One Product (ODOP) initiative. The paper examines the growing domestic and international demand for handcrafted ethnic footwear and explores how Kolhapuri Chappals can be positioned successfully in global markets through retail export strategies, branding, and digital commerce.

AI.tldr: 本研究聚焦印度马哈拉施特拉邦科尔哈普尔地区具有地理标志（GI）认证的传统皮革手工鞋品——科尔哈普尔拖鞋，探讨在印度政府"一区一品"（ODOP）计划下，如何通过零售出口策略、品牌建设和数字商务将其成功推向全球市场。
AI.research_question: 科尔哈普尔拖鞋在"一区一品"计划框架下，如何通过零售出口策略、品牌化和数字商务实现全球市场定位与出口潜力开发？
AI.motivation: 传统手工纺织品和鞋类产品面临全球化竞争，科尔哈普尔拖鞋虽具有独特文化和工艺价值，但国际市场份额有限。在ODOP政策支持下，探索其零售出口潜力有助于保护传统手工艺、促进地方经济发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地理标志（GI）理论、零售出口策略、品牌化理论、数字商务/电子商务理论、产品定位理论
AI.method: 文献综述与定性分析（基于摘要推断，具体方法需进一步查看全文）
AI.findings: 国内和国际对手工民族鞋类产品的需求正在增长；科尔哈普尔拖鞋在零售出口、品牌化和数字商务方面具有全球化定位的潜力。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了地理标志产品国际化与零售出口策略相结合的理论研究，扩展了"一区一品"政策框架下传统手工艺品的全球市场进入理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为科尔哈普尔拖鞋生产商、出口商及政策制定者提供了品牌化与数字化转型的具体路径，助力传统手工艺通过ODOP政策实现国际市场竞争力的提升。

title: What Students Get: AI Failure Modes Across K-12 Subject Areas in Texas, New York, and Mississippi Working Paper -Draft in Progress

detail.title: What Students Get: AI Failure Modes Across K-12 Subject Areas in Texas, New York, and Mississippi Working Paper -Draft in Progress
detail.abstract:
With 86% of students now using AI tools for schoolwork, the gap between AI use and AI literacy has become a structural problem in American education. This paper presents field research testing three commercially available AI systems — Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini — across 30 prompts in chemistry, civic history, and English literature. Test corpora were developed from publicly available curriculum standards in Texas, New York, and Mississippi, with prompts written in realistic student voice and scored on a six-dimension universal rubric supplemented by category-specific dimensions.

The study identifies a clear failure mode gradient: AI performs best on well-defined factual tasks (chemistry, mean 2.82–2.96 per dimension), worse on contested historical narratives (civic history, 2.81–2.96), and worst on literary interpretation (literature, 2.54–2.85). Model rankings reverse across domains, and hallucination clusters in specialized disciplinary vocabulary where students are least equipped to detect it. The paper argues that the dominant "cheating" framing misidentifies a literacy problem as a behavioral one, and contributes both empirical evidence of subject-specific failure modes and a replicable evaluation framework that educators can apply without technical expertise.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实证研究发现，AI在化学、公民历史、英语文学三类学科任务中表现存在显著梯度差异（化学最佳，文学最差），模型排名随学科领域反转，且幻觉集中于学生最难以识别的专业术语领域。论文批判了将AI使用简单归为"作弊"的主流框架，指出这实质是一个素养问题而非行为问题。
AI.research_question: AI系统在不同学科（化学、公民历史、英语文学）的学术任务中表现是否存在系统性差异？这些差异如何揭示AI素养与AI使用之间的结构性鸿沟？
AI.motivation: 86%的学生已使用AI工具完成学业，但AI使用与AI素养之间存在巨大鸿沟，而主流话语将这一问题简单框定为"作弊"行为，忽视了其作为素养问题的本质。需要实证研究来揭示AI在不同学科中的具体失败模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI素养理论、"作弊"框架批判（将素养问题误判为行为问题）、学科特异性认知理论（不同学科的认知任务对AI能力需求不同）。
AI.method: 现场实验：测试三个商用AI系统（Claude、ChatGPT、Gemini），使用30个提示词覆盖化学、公民历史、英语文学三个学科。测试语料来自德克萨斯、纽约、密西西比州的公开课程标准，提示词以真实学生语气编写，采用六维度通用评分量表和学科特定维度进行评分。
AI.findings: (1) AI存在清晰的失败模式梯度：化学（定义明确的事实性任务）表现最佳（均分2.82-2.96），公民历史（有争议的历史叙事）次之（2.81-2.96），英语文学（文学解读）最差（2.54-2.85）；(2) 模型排名在不同学科中发生反转；(3) 幻觉集中出现在学生最难以识别的专业学科术语领域。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 提供了学科特异性AI失败模式的实证证据，挑战了将AI视为"通用工具"的假设；(2) 批判并重构了"作弊"框架，论证其将素养问题误判为行为问题；(3) 引入"失败模式梯度"概念，揭示了AI能力在不同认知任务类型间的非均匀分布。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 开发了无需技术专业知识即可应用的可复制评估框架，赋能教育工作者自主评估AI工具；(2) 为教育政策制定者提供了学科层面的AI使用指导依据；(3) 提醒教育者关注学生最易受AI误导的专业术语领域，指导AI素养教育重点。

title: Data Mining for Retail Product Recommendation using Data Analysis

detail.title: Data Mining for Retail Product Recommendation using Data Analysis
detail.abstract: This research paper focuses on the use of data mining techniques to develop product recommendation systems in retail environments. By analyzing customer transaction data and purchasing behavior, the study identifies patterns and relationships between products. Using techniques such as Association Rule Mining, Clustering, and Classification, the research aims to improve recommendation accuracy and customer satisfaction. The findings help retailers optimize sales strategies, enhance user experience, and improve decision-making. The study also incorporates recommendation algorithms, including collaborative filtering and content-based filtering, to generate personalized product suggestions. Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) is performed to understand the dataset and extract meaningful insights. The performance of the recommendation system is evaluated using metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and support-confidence measures. The results indicate that data mining significantly improves the relevance and efficiency of product recommendations, leading to increased customer satisfaction, better decision-making, and higher sales.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用数据挖掘技术（关联规则、聚类、分类）构建零售产品推荐系统，通过分析客户交易数据提升推荐准确性和客户满意度，最终促进销售增长。
AI.research_question: 如何利用数据挖掘技术开发有效的产品推荐系统，以提高零售环境中的推荐准确性和客户满意度？
AI.motivation: 零售环境中产品种类繁多，传统推荐方法难以精准捕捉客户需求，数据挖掘技术可以揭示隐藏的购买模式，从而优化推荐效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关联规则挖掘（Association Rule Mining）、聚类分析（Clustering）、分类算法（Classification）、协同过滤（Collaborative Filtering）、基于内容的过滤（Content-based Filtering）
AI.method: 采用数据挖掘技术（关联规则挖掘、聚类、分类）和推荐算法（协同过滤、基于内容的过滤），结合探索性数据分析（EDA），并使用准确率、精确率、召回率、支持度和置信度等指标评估系统性能。
AI.findings: 数据挖掘显著提升了产品推荐的相关性和效率，提高了客户满意度、优化了决策过程，并促进了销售额增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了多种数据挖掘技术（关联规则、聚类、分类）与推荐算法（协同过滤、基于内容的过滤）在零售产品推荐中的有效整合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为零售商提供了可操作的推荐系统构建方法，帮助优化销售策略、提升用户体验、改善决策质量，从而实现更高的客户满意度和销售额。

title: Generational views on accounting: A case study on Gen Z
affiliations: San Francisco State University, ESCP Business School and York University - Schulich School of Business

detail.title: Generational views on accounting: A case study on Gen Z

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: As questions are being raised in the field of accounting about the role it plays within environmental initiatives, intergenerational perspectives, including the values that underpin them, remain largely absent from the development of accounting standard-setting processes and principles. Gen Z is becoming increasingly visible in sustainability debates, assuming 'emerging' leadership roles in shaping broader societal discussions, while living with many nuances that raise important questions about their views of accounting principles. Drawing on qualitative vignette-based interviews, we explore how members of Gen Z make sense of 'traditional' accounting principles (e.g., quantification, objectivity, expertise) and 'alternative' approaches characterized by narratives, emotions, and nonexpert perspectives in the context of a sustainability project. Our findings indicate a pronounced openness toward socially oriented forms of 'alternative' accounting, often grounded in participants' lived experiences and socio-political contexts. However, this openness coexists with persistent attachments to numbers, professional expertise, and claims of objectivity. We also observe intragenerational tensions around engagement and contested values. This study highlights the importance of incorporating generational perspectives into debates on the future of accounting, particularly in relation to sustainability, to address declining student interest in accounting and reflect on its emancipatory potential in the context of current social and environmental crises.

AI.tldr: 本文通过质性 vignette 访谈，探讨 Z 世代如何在可持续项目中理解“传统”会计原则（量化、客观性、专业性）与“替代性”会计方法（叙事、情感、非专家视角），发现他们对社会导向的替代性会计持开放态度，但同时依然依赖数字与专业权威，并存在代内张力。
AI.research_question: Z 世代如何理解传统会计原则与替代性会计方法在可持续项目中的应用？其价值观如何影响会计原则的认知？
AI.motivation: 会计领域在环境倡议中作用受到质疑，但代际视角（尤其是价值观层面）在会计标准制定中长期缺席。Z 世代在可持续辩论中日益突出，其对会计原则的看法值得深入探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代际价值观理论、会计原则的社会建构、替代性会计（叙事、情感、非专家视角）
AI.method: 质性 vignette 式访谈
AI.findings: Z 世代对社会导向的替代性会计持开放态度，这种态度植根于其生活经历和社会政治背景；但同时仍对数字、专业知识和客观性有持久依赖；代内存在关于参与和价值观的张力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将代际视角系统引入会计原则讨论，揭示传统与替代会计认知的共存机制，识别代内价值观张力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为会计教育应对学生兴趣下降提供启示，推动会计标准制定过程纳入代际视角以回应可持续危机，反思会计的解放潜力。

title: Documentary Credit and Documentary Collection in Export Trade: Traditional Practices and the Role of Artificial Intelligence

detail.title: Documentary Credit and Documentary Collection in Export Trade: Traditional Practices and the Role of Artificial Intelligence
detail.abstract:
This paper explains the concept of Documentary Credit (Letter of Credit) and Documentary Collection used in international trade finance. It discusses their meaning, types, working procedures, parties involved, and key documents required in export-import transactions. The study also compares Documentary Credit and Documentary Collection on the basis of risk, security, cost, and suitability in international business.

Special emphasis has been given to the role of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in modern trade finance. The paper highlights practical applications of AI such as automated document verification, fraud detection, sanctions screening, predictive risk analysis, and digital trade finance platforms. AI technologies including OCR, machine learning, blockchain integration, and NLP are transforming traditional paper-based systems into faster, more secure, and efficient processes.

The study concludes that while traditional trade finance instruments remain essential for international trade, AI is significantly improving accuracy, reducing processing time, and minimizing operational risks in export-import transactions.

AI.tldr: 本文系统阐述了跟单信用证和跟单托收两种国际贸易融资工具的概念、类型、流程、参与方及所需单据，并对比了二者在风险、安全性、成本及适用性方面的差异。重点分析了人工智能（OCR、机器学习、区块链、自然语言处理等技术）在贸易融资中的实际应用，如自动单据审核、欺诈检测、制裁筛查、风险预测及数字化平台，指出AI正在提升传统纸质系统的效率、准确性和安全性。
AI.research_question: 跟单信用证与跟单托收在国际贸易融资中有何异同？人工智能如何改变传统贸易融资流程并提升效率与安全性？
AI.motivation: 国际贸易融资中传统纸质流程效率低、风险高，亟需了解AI技术如何优化传统贸易融资工具的应用效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际贸易融资理论（跟单信用证与跟单托收的运行机制）、人工智能技术应用理论（OCR、机器学习、区块链、自然语言处理在金融领域的整合）
AI.method: 概念阐释与比较分析方法，结合AI技术在贸易融资中的实际应用案例进行定性分析。
AI.findings: 跟单信用证较跟单托收在风险与安全性上更优，但成本更高；AI技术（如自动单据审核、欺诈检测、区块链整合）显著提升了贸易融资的处理速度、准确性，降低了操作风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了传统贸易融资工具与AI技术的交叉应用框架，拓展了贸易融资理论在数字化背景下的解释力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为进出口企业、银行及金融机构提供了AI赋能贸易融资的具体应用场景和操作指南，有助于推动贸易融资流程的数字化转型。

title: The Impact Of The Operational Management Style On The Employee Performance In Facility Management In Saudi Arabia

detail.title: The Impact Of The Operational Management Style On The Employee Performance In Facility Management In Saudi Arabia

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involved human participants through the distribution of structured questionnaires to employees within facility management organizations in Saudi Arabia. Participation was voluntary, and informed consent was obtained from all participants prior to data collection. Respondents were assured of confidentiality and anonymity, and no personally identifiable information was collected. The research was conducted in accordance with academic ethical standards for social science research.

detail.abstract:
This doctoral research investigates the impact of operational management style on employee performance within facility management organizations in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA). The study addresses a critical gap in the literature by focusing on leadership and management practices in technical, high-risk, and performance-driven operational environments. Given the strategic importance of facility management in supporting infrastructure reliability, safety, and service quality under Saudi Vision 2030, understanding the relationship between management behavior and workforce performance is essential.

A quantitative research design was employed using a structured questionnaire distributed to 400 employees across facility management organizations in Saudi Arabia. The study examined the influence of five management styles—transformational, democratic, transactional, laissez-faire, and authoritarian—on employee performance indicators such as work quality, teamwork, punctuality, innovation, and safety compliance. Statistical analysis included descriptive statistics, reliability testing, correlation analysis, and regression modeling.

The findings demonstrate that transformational and democratic management styles have the strongest positive effects on employee performance, while transactional management provides moderate benefits in structured operational contexts. Conversely, laissez-faire and authoritarian approaches showed limited or negative influence on morale, communication, and long-term productivity. The study contributes empirical evidence to management theory while offering practical recommendations for leadership development in the Saudi facility management sector.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨沙特阿拉伯设施管理组织中运营管理风格对员工绩效的影响，发现变革型和民主型管理风格对员工绩效的正面影响最强，而放任型和独裁型风格效果有限或为负面。
AI.research_question: 在沙特阿拉伯设施管理组织中，不同的运营管理风格（变革型、民主型、交易型、放任型、独裁型）如何影响员工绩效（工作质量、团队合作、守时、创新、安全合规）？
AI.motivation: 设施管理对基础设施可靠性、安全性和服务质量具有战略重要性，尤其是在沙特2030愿景背景下。然而，针对技术性、高风险、绩效驱动的运营环境中的领导力和管理实践，文献中存在明显空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 管理风格理论（变革型、民主型、交易型、放任型、独裁型五种管理风格）与员工绩效理论（工作质量、团队合作、守时、创新、安全合规等绩效指标）。
AI.method: 定量研究设计，向沙特阿拉伯设施管理组织的400名员工发放结构化问卷，采用描述性统计、信度检验、相关分析和回归模型进行数据分析。
AI.findings: 变革型和民主型管理风格对员工绩效的正向影响最强；交易型管理在结构化运营环境中提供中等程度的益处；放任型和独裁型风格对士气、沟通和长期生产力产生有限或负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为管理理论提供了来自沙特设施管理行业的实证证据，填补了关于技术性、高风险运营环境中管理风格与员工绩效关系的研究空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为沙特设施管理行业的领导力发展提供了实践性建议，有助于优化管理实践以提升员工绩效，支持沙特2030愿景的实施。

title: MEDIATING RIVALRY: PAKISTAN'S ROLE AS A MIDDLE POWER IN UNITED STATES-IRAN RELATIONS

detail.title: MEDIATING RIVALRY: PAKISTAN'S ROLE AS A MIDDLE POWER IN UNITED STATES-IRAN RELATIONS

declarations.funderStatement: I believe this study holds great significance for Pakistan as a nation that has stretched to the utmost for maintaining peace in the region.

keywords: Pakistan as a major power in the South Asia

detail.abstract: This paper focuses on how Pakistan has mediated in the long-standing strategic rivalry between the United States and Iran, a conflict of nuclear competition, coercive sanctions, and structural mistrust. The study is based on the mediation theory and the middle-power diplomacy, which implies a qualitative case study approach based on secondary data from academic literature, policy reports, and geopolitical developments occurring between 2015 and 2026. The analysis concludes that the role of Pakistan is more of a facilitative one, focused on maintaining backchannel communication and facilitating short-term de-escalation and not structural conflict resolution. The instrumental performance of Pakistan depends on the relational positioning, which allows it to act as a channel of indirect participation in the highly limited diplomatic space. Yet its influence is limited by the structural asymmetries, conflicting regional interests, and the lack of political determination among the major players. The mediation of Pakistan, therefore, is indicative of a greater change in international relations, where middle powers play a role in conflict management by informal and situational, as opposed to formal, negotiation networks. The work fills a literature gap on the topic of third-party mediation in the relations between the USA and Iran, which helps comprehend how the emergent actors can overcome the intricate geopolitical disputes.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨巴基斯坦如何在美国与伊朗之间长期战略对抗中发挥调解作用，结论显示其角色更多是促进性的，侧重于维持后台沟通和短期降级，而非结构性冲突解决。
AI.research_question: 巴基斯坦如何在美伊长期战略对抗中发挥调解作用？其调解效果与局限性是什么？
AI.motivation: 美伊之间的核竞争、强制制裁与结构性不信任长期存在，而第三方调解在中东地缘政治中的作用日益凸显，但关于巴基斯坦作为调解方的研究存在文献空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 调解理论（Mediation Theory）与中等强国 diplomacy（Middle-Power Diplomacy）。
AI.method: 定性案例研究方法，基于2015-2026年间学术文献、政策报告和地缘政治发展的二手数据。
AI.findings: 巴基斯坦的角色是促进性的（facilitative），侧重于维持后台沟通和短期降级，而非结构性冲突解决。其调解绩效依赖于关系定位（relational positioning），但在结构性不对称、区域利益冲突和主要大国缺乏政治决心的情况下影响力有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了美伊关系中第三方调解的研究空白，揭示了中等强国通过非正式、情境性的谈判网络参与冲突管理的机制，反映了国际关系中冲突管理模式的转变。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解新兴行为体如何应对复杂地缘政治争端提供了实践参考，为中等强国在有限外交空间中发挥调解作用提供了经验证据。

title: Socio-economic development of the northern regions

detail.title: Socio-economic development of the northern regions
detail.abstract: Paper examines key areas of socioeconomic development in Russia's northern regions. It substantiates the need to create a Trans-Arctic Corridor, encompassing the comprehensive development of land-based inland waterway transport and the integration of Siberian rivers with the Northern Sea Route, as well as their connection with the Baikal-Amur Mainline (BAM), the Trans-Siberian Railway, and meridional infrastructure. Special attention is given to the implementation of master plans for Arctic and Far Eastern cities as a means of improving quality of life. It is shown that the synergy between transport and social projects enhances the impact of the national projects "Demography," "Healthcare," and "Education," helping to anchor the population in the North and transform resource enclaves into areas of sustainable development.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了在俄罗斯北部地区建设跨北极走廊的必要性，该走廊整合内陆水运、西伯利亚河流与北方海路，并连接贝阿铁路、西伯利亚大铁路及经向基础设施。同时强调实施北极和远东城市总体规划以提升生活质量，指出交通与社会项目的协同效应有助于巩固北方人口、将资源飞地转变为可持续发展区域。
AI.research_question: 如何通过构建跨北极交通走廊及实施城市总体规划，促进俄罗斯北部地区的社会经济发展，实现从资源型飞地向可持续发展区域的转型？
AI.motivation: 俄罗斯北部地区面临人口流失、基础设施薄弱、资源依赖性强等发展困境，亟需通过综合交通网络与城市社会项目的协同来破解发展瓶颈，实现人口锚定和可持续发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区域经济学中的交通基础设施乘数效应、增长极理论；社会基础设施与人口锚定的协同发展理论；资源型区域转型理论。
AI.method: 规范性论证与政策分析，综合运用区域发展规划、国家项目评估与基础设施网络分析等方法。
AI.findings: 1) 跨北极走廊的构建需要陆路内河水运、西伯利亚河流、北方海路、贝阿铁路、西伯利亚大铁路及经向基础设施的系统整合；2) 北极和远东城市总体规划是提升居民生活质量的关键手段；3) 交通项目与社会项目（人口、医疗、教育）的协同效应能增强国家项目效果，有效锚定北方人口，推动资源飞地向可持续发展区域转型。
AI.theory_contributions: 将交通走廊建设与社会基础设施规划整合为统一的区域发展框架，拓展了资源型区域转型的理论视角，提出了交通-社会项目协同的"锚定效应"理论逻辑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为俄罗斯北部地区提供了一套可操作的跨北极走廊建设方案，明确了国家项目（人口、医疗、教育）与交通基础设施协同实施的路径，对北极和远东城市总体规划具有直接指导意义。

title: The General Theory of Management: Fundamental Theory of Management

detail.title: The General Theory of Management: Fundamental Theory of Management

keywords: The problem of creating a social theory based on the natural science approach.
The collapse of the organization begins with the hiring of the first employee. Decay informational

detail.abstract:
In my previous work «The General Theory of Management. Formulation of the problem» I formulated a series of questions that I could not find scientifically based answers:

«1. Management.

What is the difference from Operation, Administration, Handling, Control, Regulation and so on?

When there is obvious necessity in it?

2. Manager.

What his most important task as a class?

What are the limits of its competences?

Exclusive competence (only he and no one else)?

So, I had to start giving answers myself.

AI.tldr: 本文延续了作者先前关于《一般管理理论》的研究，针对管理、管理者等一系列基础性问题，提出了自己的回答和理论构建。
AI.research_question: 管理的本质是什么？管理者最重要的任务、能力边界、在公司结构中的位置、专属权限、出现与消失的条件是什么？公司的主要行动者是谁？管理者与其他行动者之间的关系是什么？
AI.motivation: 作者在先前研究中发现，管理学领域对一系列基础性问题缺乏科学依据的答案，因此不得不自行尝试给出回答。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一般管理理论（General Theory of Management）的延续与深化。
AI.method: 理论推导与概念辨析。
AI.findings: 尚未在摘要中明确呈现具体发现，摘要仅表明作者将针对所提出的系列问题给出自己的回答。
AI.theory_contributions: 尝试澄清管理、管理者等核心概念的定义与边界，为管理学科提供更坚实的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助管理者明确自身角色定位、职责范围及在公司中的存在价值，提升管理实践的有效性。

title: Export documentation and Role of AI

detail.title: Export documentation and Role of AI
detail.abstract: Export documentation refers to the set of official papers and records required to complete an international shipment of goods from one country to another. Export documentation is the process of preparing and submitting all required documents that enable goods to be exported legally and smoothly across international borders. These documents serve as proof of transaction, ownership, compliance, and shipment details, and are necessary for customs clearance, payment processing, and legal purposes Purpose of Export Documentation-Export documentation is important because it:  Ensures compliance with international trade laws and regulations  Facilitates customs clearance in both exporting and importing countries  Provides evidence for payment (especially in methods like Letters of Credit)  Acts as proof of shipment and ownership  Helps in resolving disputes between buyer and seller .

AI.tldr: 本文系统阐述了出口单证的概念、范围、流程及其在国际贸易中的重要作用，强调单证是确保货物合法、顺利跨境流动的核心工具。
AI.research_question: 出口单证在国际贸易中扮演什么角色？其目的和重要性体现在哪些方面？
AI.motivation: 帮助从业者理解出口单证的必要性，确保贸易合规、通关顺畅、支付安全，并减少买卖双方纠纷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际贸易合规理论、信用证支付机制、海关通关流程理论。
AI.method: 概念梳理与功能分析（描述性研究）。

title: THE ASCENT READINESS GAP: Why the Manager-to-Leader-of-Leaders Transition Fails

detail.title: THE ASCENT READINESS GAP: Why the Manager-to-Leader-of-Leaders Transition Fails

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of BlackRidge Institute and developer of the Leadership Readiness Diagnostic and the Four Leadership Transitions framework. BlackRidge Systems, LLC is a commercial entity that markets and licenses these instruments. This interest is disclosed in accordance with standard academic transparency practices.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper presents a conceptual framework and applied research synthesis. No human subject research was conducted. No institutional ethics approval was required or obtained.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All research and development costs were borne by BlackRidge Systems, LLC.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the ASCENT readiness gap, the point at which proven first-line managers are promoted into leader-of-leaders roles without adequate preparation for the systems-level, indirect, and developmental demands the transition requires. Drawing on peer-reviewed research in leadership development, organizational psychology, and transition theory, combined with longitudinal practitioner observation across operational environments, the paper argues that first-line management success often predicts ASCENT transition risk rather than transition success, that post-promotion development is structurally insufficient at the leader-of-leaders level, and that a diagnostic-first approach to readiness assessment can materially change outcomes. Existing research consistently identifies recurring failure patterns at the manager-to-leader-of-leaders transition, including direct-execution persistence, systems-thinking deficits, manager-development avoidance, and misalignment between first-line management identity and senior leadership role demands. These dimensions are typically addressed in isolation by existing programs. This paper integrates these findings and positions ASCENT failure not as a generic capability gap but as a readiness failure, a predictable and assessable condition that precedes promotion rather than follows it. The paper introduces the Leadership Readiness Diagnostic (LRD) at the ASCENT level, a developmentfocused, behaviorally anchored instrument designed to evaluate readiness indicators such as systems thinking capacity, organizational navigation, people development orientation, and strategic patience prior to role assumption. It proposes a readiness system architecture, presents a research-informed organizational scenario, and establishes a foundation for future empirical validation of manager-to-leaderof-leaders readiness as a measurable construct. The framework is applicable across corporate, military, and institutional environments.

AI.tldr: 本文聚焦"ASCENT准备度缺口"——即一线经理人晋升为领导者之领导者时，因缺乏系统层面、间接性和发展性要求所需准备而失败的现象。文章整合现有研究，提出ASCENT失败本质上是可预测、可评估的"准备度失败"，而非通用能力缺口，并引入领导力准备度诊断工具(LRD)及准备度系统架构，为未来实证验证奠定基础。
AI.research_question: 一线经理人晋升为领导者之领导者时，为何会出现系统性的ASCENT准备度缺口？如何通过诊断前置的方式改善这一过渡的成功率？
AI.motivation: 实证观察和现有研究反复表明，一线经理人晋升为领导者之领导者时存在高失败率，而现有项目往往孤立地处理各维度问题，缺乏整合性的前置诊断框架。作者试图将这一现象从"能力缺口"重新定义为"准备度失败"，从而改变干预时机和方式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 领导力发展理论、组织心理学、过渡理论；核心概念包括：ASCENT准备度缺口、直接执行惯性、系统思维缺陷、管理者发展回避、一线管理身份与高层角色要求之间的错位。
AI.method: 对领导力发展、组织心理学和过渡理论的同行评审研究进行文献整合，结合跨运营环境的纵向实践观察。提出概念性框架（领导力准备度诊断LRD）和准备度系统架构，并以研究驱动的组织情景进行说明。
AI.findings: (1) 一线管理成功反而常预测ASCENT过渡风险而非成功；(2) 晋升后发展在领导者之领导者层面结构性不足；(3) 存在四种典型失败模式：直接执行惯性、系统思维缺陷、管理者发展回避、身份错位；(4) ASCENT失败是"准备度失败"——一种可预测、可评估、先于晋升发生的条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 将ASCENT失败从通用能力缺口重新概念化为准备度失败，整合了以往孤立对待的四个失败维度，提出了可测量的"管理者到领导者之领导者准备度"构念，为后续实证研究奠定理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了行为锚定的领导力准备度诊断工具(LRD)，涵盖系统思维、组织导航、人员发展导向、战略耐心等关键指标；提出准备度系统架构；框架适用于企业、军事和机构等多种组织环境，为组织优化晋升决策和前置发展干预提供可操作路径。

title: The Source Traffic Light: A Six-Dimensional Credibility Framework for Systematic Source Assessment in Public Service Media

detail.title: The Source Traffic Light: A Six-Dimensional Credibility Framework for Systematic Source Assessment in Public Service Media

declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded.

detail.abstract: We present the Quellenampel (Source Traffic Light), a six-dimensional framework for the systematic assessment of source credibility in public service media (PSM) broadcasts. The framework evaluates every cited source, expert, or factual claim along six complementary dimensions: conflict of interest, personal risk exposure, domain expertise, opinion consistency, argumentation quality, and source proximity. Each dimension produces a score on a bounded scale; the aggregate is translated into a traffic light classification (green, yellow, red) indicating overall source credibility. A companion instrument, the Glaubwürdigkeits-Matrix (Credibility Matrix), provides a condensed two-dimensional classification along the conflict-of-interest and personal-risk axes, capturing the structural credibility asymmetry that conventional journalistic source evaluation systematically overlooks. Applied to a corpus of over 5,000 analysed broadcasts from Swiss, German, and Norwegian public television, the framework reveals three findings. First, PSM programmes routinely present secondary and tertiary sources as established fact without disclosing the evidentiary distance from primary data. Second, 78% of Swiss media articles rely on agency dispatches (fög, 2024), creating source proximity chains that are invisible to the audience. Third, structural conflicts of interest among cited experts are disclosed in fewer than 15% of cases where such conflicts are identifiable from public records. The Quellenampel operationalises source credibility assessment in a format compatible with regulatory proceedings under Article 4 RTVG (Switzerland), the Medienstaatsvertrag (Germany), and equivalent European PSM statutes. To our knowledge, this is the first systematic, multi-dimensional source credibility framework designed specifically for application to PSM broadcast content at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Quellenampel（来源交通灯），一个六维度的来源可信度评估框架，用于公共广播媒体。通过分析5000多个广播节目，发现公共广播媒体普遍存在不披露证据距离、依赖通讯社稿件（78%）以及专家利益冲突披露率低（<15%）等问题。
AI.research_question: 如何系统性地评估公共广播媒体（PSM）节目中引用来源、专家或事实主张的可信度？
AI.motivation: 传统新闻来源评估方法忽视了结构性可信度不对称，且缺乏适用于公共广播媒体的大规模、多维度的系统评估工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 来源可信度理论、利益冲突与个人风险暴露的对称性理论、证据链理论。
AI.method: 开发Quellenampel六维度框架（利益冲突、个人风险暴露、领域专长、观点一致性、论证质量、来源接近性），配合Glaubwürdigkeits-Matrix二维分类，对瑞士、德国、挪威公共电视台5000多个广播节目进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 1. 公共广播媒体常将二三级来源当作既定事实呈现，不披露与一手数据之间的证据距离；2. 78%的瑞士媒体文章依赖通讯社稿件，形成观众看不见的来源接近性链条；3. 可识别的专家利益冲突在不到15%的案例中被披露。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出并验证了适用于公共广播媒体的系统性、多维度的来源可信度评估框架，揭示了传统新闻评估中忽视的结构性可信度不对称问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 该框架可应用于瑞士RTVG第4条、德国Medienstaatsvertrag等欧洲公共广播法规的监管程序，为提升新闻透明度和问责制提供了可操作的工具。

title:
Life-Cycle Cumulative Labeling Theory (LCCLT): A
Conceptual Sociological Model of Behaviour and
Productivity

detail.title:
Life-Cycle Cumulative Labeling Theory (LCCLT): A
Conceptual Sociological Model of Behaviour and
Productivity
detail.abstract:
This paper develops a conceptual sociological model, the Life-Cycle Cumulative Labeling
Theory (LCCLT), to explain how social labels experienced by individuals throughout their
life influence their behaviour and productivity. Unlike traditional labelling perspectives that
concentrate mainly on deviance, this study adopts a broader view by examining both positive
and negative labels across different stages of life. The model introduces the idea of
cumulative label internalization, where repeated exposure to social categorization gradually
shapes self-perception and behavioural patterns. A cyclical relationship between labelling,
identity formation, and productivity outcomes is proposed. The study contributes by
connecting sociological identity processes with performance-related outcomes in modern,
evaluation-heavy societies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了生命周期累积标签理论（LCCLT），探讨个体一生中经历的社会标签如何影响其行为与生产力，强调标签的累积内化过程以及标签、身份认同与生产力之间的循环关系。
AI.research_question: 社会标签如何通过个体一生中的累积内化过程影响其行为与生产力？
AI.motivation: 传统标签理论主要关注负面偏差标签，忽略了正面标签以及标签在生命不同阶段的累积效应。现代社会中评价体系日益密集，需要一个更全面的理论框架来理解标签对个体身份与绩效的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生命周期累积标签理论（Life-Cycle Cumulative Labeling Theory, LCCLT），整合了标签理论、身份形成理论与累积效应视角。
AI.method: 概念性社会学模型构建，属于理论推演型研究。
AI.findings: 提出了标签累积内化的概念：重复暴露于社会分类会逐渐塑造自我认知和行为模式；揭示了标签、身份认同与生产力结果之间的循环关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了传统标签理论的视野，将正面与负面标签纳入统一框架；引入生命周期视角，强调标签的累积性而非单次影响；将社会学身份过程与绩效结果联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 为现代评价密集型社会（如职场绩效评估、教育评分体系等）提供了理解标签长期影响的分析工具，有助于设计更公平的社会评价机制。

title: The Role of HRM Practices in Moderating Biophilic Design and Digital Detox for Knowledge Workers

detail.title: The Role of HRM Practices in Moderating Biophilic Design and Digital Detox for Knowledge Workers

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: In modern high-pressure corporate environments, knowledge workers frequently face cognitive fatigue and technostress due to constant digital connectivity and sterile workspace designs. This study investigates the impact of biophilic office design and structured digital detox integrations on employee cognitive restoration, creative output, and psychological resilience. It specifically examines how Human Resource Management (HRM) practices serve as a critical moderator in successfully implementing and sustaining these wellness-focused strategies. The research concludes that a holistic approach combining environmental psychology and proactive management is vital for the future of knowledge-work organizations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究亲生物办公室设计与数字排毒整合对知识工作者认知恢复、创造力及心理韧性的影响，并探讨人力资源管理实践如何作为关键调节变量推动这些健康策略的实施与持续。
AI.research_question: 亲生物办公室设计与结构化数字排毒整合如何影响知识工作者的认知恢复、创造性产出和心理韧性？人力资源管理实践如何调节这些影响？
AI.motivation: 现代高压企业环境中，知识工作者因持续的数字连接和单调的办公空间设计，面临认知疲劳和技术压力的日益加剧，亟需有效的干预策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境心理学；人力资源管理（HRM）调节作用理论；认知恢复理论
AI.method: 未明确具体方法，基于摘要推测为实证研究（可能涉及问卷调查或实验设计）。
AI.findings: 亲生物设计（如绿植、自然光等）与数字排毒策略能有效促进认知恢复、提升创造力与心理韧性；HRM实践在其中起到关键的调节作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 将环境心理学与人力资源管理理论相结合，拓展了亲生物设计和数字排毒在组织行为学领域的理论应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为知识型企业提供了将办公空间改造与主动式人力资源管理相结合的健康策略实践指南。

title: Prediction Markets as a Money Laundering Vector: The Coordinated Loss Problem

detail.title: Prediction Markets as a Money Laundering Vector: The Coordinated Loss Problem

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no financial relationship with Polymarket, Kalshi, or any prediction market platform.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded and conducted independently through Third Door Fund.

detail.abstract: Prediction markets have grown from a niche academic curiosity into mainstream financial infrastructure. Polymarket processed $12 billion in monthly volume in January 2026 and is now valued at $9 billion. This growth has outpaced regulatory frameworks designed for traditional financial instruments. This paper identifies a specific and underexamined vulnerability: coordinated loss exploitation, a scheme in which illicit funds are distributed across hundreds of accounts betting on the losing side of a binary prediction contract, while a single account holds a large position on the winning side. When the contract resolves, the winning account collects the full pool minus a platform fee of approximately 2%, effectively laundering the original capital at a cost of roughly 2 cents on the dollar. This is cheaper than any comparable laundering method documented in existing financial crime literature. The scheme exploits the structural opacity of decentralized platforms, the absence of unified KYC enforcement across international markets, and the lack of automatic payout reporting requirements. This paper describes the mechanics of the exploit, provides a data simulation illustrating what the scheme would look like in on-chain transaction data, evaluates its detection difficulty under current compliance frameworks, and proposes a targeted policy response drawing on lessons from AML regulation in sports betting, securities law, and decentralized finance.

AI.tldr: 本文识别并分析了一种新型金融犯罪——"协调性损失利用"（Coordinated Loss Exploitation），即利用预测市场（如Polymarket）的结构性漏洞，通过分布在数百个账户上的非法资金押注失败方，同时单一账户押注获胜方，以约2%的成本实现洗钱。该方案比现有任何可比洗钱手段成本更低，当前监管框架难以有效检测。
AI.research_question: 预测市场中"协调性损失利用"这一洗钱方案的具体机制是什么？其检测难度如何？应如何制定针对性监管对策？
AI.motivation: 预测市场（如Polymarket）规模快速增长，月交易量达120亿美元、估值90亿美元，但监管框架尚未跟上；现有金融犯罪文献未涉及这种新型洗钱模式，且该模式洗钱成本极低（约2%）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 反洗钱（AML）监管理论、金融犯罪经济学、去中心化金融（DeFi）结构性漏洞分析、体育博彩与证券法中的反洗钱经验。
AI.method: 机制建模与描述、链上交易数据模拟、现有合规框架下检测难度评估、跨领域政策比较分析。
AI.findings: 该洗钱方案成本约2美分/美元，低于任何现有可比方案；利用了去中心化平台的结构性不透明性、缺乏统一KYC执行、以及缺乏自动赔付报告要求；现有合规框架难以检测。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次识别并系统阐述预测市场中的"协调性损失利用"洗钱机制，填补了金融犯罪文献在该领域的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了基于体育博彩AML监管、证券法与DeFi监管经验的针对性政策建议，为监管机构应对预测市场洗钱风险提供操作框架。

title: Spotting Rare Bias in How Automated Vehicles Treat Pedestrians: An Adversarial Anomaly Detection Approach

detail.title: Spotting Rare Bias in How Automated Vehicles Treat Pedestrians: An Adversarial Anomaly Detection Approach
detail.abstract: Automated vehicles (AVs) are increasingly trained on human driving data, which may embed subtle, socially biased behaviors that occur too rarely to be captured by standard fairness audits. This paper addresses the problem of detecting rare but systematic discriminatory patterns in AV-pedestrian interactions-specifically, instances where an AV's yielding behavior, stopping distance, or hesitation time differs based on pedestrian appearance or contextual social cues (e.g., perceived age, gender, or dress). We propose an adversarial anomaly detection framework that learns the distribution of normal, unbiased AV driving behaviors and then adversarially searches for low-probability yet high-concern events indicative of discrimination. Unlike threshold-based or aggregate fairness metrics, our method is designed to surface sparse, edge-case biases that could otherwise go unnoticed in validation datasets. Experimental evaluations on simulated and naturalistic AV-pedestrian encounter data demonstrate the framework's ability to identify previously undetected biased patterns while maintaining low false-positive rates. Our work provides a new computational tool for auditing autonomous systems for social fairness, with direct implications for equitable AV deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种对抗性异常检测框架，用于识别自动驾驶车辆与行人交互中罕见但系统性的社会偏见行为（如基于行人外貌的避让差异），该方法能发现传统公平审计遗漏的稀疏边缘偏见案例。
AI.research_question: 如何检测自动驾驶车辆在与行人交互中存在的罕见但系统性的社会偏见行为（基于行人外貌或社会线索的避让差异）？
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶车辆基于人类驾驶数据训练，这些数据可能嵌入微妙的、社会性偏见行为，且此类偏见发生频率极低，传统公平审计（阈值法或聚合指标）无法有效捕捉。
AI.theoretical_framework: 对抗性异常检测；对抗性搜索低概率高关注事件；分布学习（正常无偏见驾驶行为分布）。
AI.method: 提出对抗性异常检测框架：先学习正常无偏见AV驾驶行为的分布，再通过对抗性搜索寻找低概率但高关注度的歧视性事件。在模拟和自然场景的AV-行人交互数据上进行实验评估。
AI.findings: 该框架能够识别先前未被检测到的偏见模式，同时保持较低的假阳性率；有效发现传统审计遗漏的稀疏边缘偏见案例。
AI.theory_contributions: 为自动驾驶系统社会公平审计提供了新的计算工具；提出对抗性异常检测方法用于发现罕见歧视模式，弥补传统公平审计方法的不足。
AI.practical_contributions: 直接促进自动驾驶车辆的公平部署；帮助确保AV在真实场景中不会基于行人外貌（年龄、性别、着装等）产生歧视性行为。

title: PROJECT REPORT ON PLANNING AND MANAGEMENT OF BIRGUNJ GREEN DRIVE: URBAN PLANTATION PROJECT ALONG THE BIRGUNJ ROAD

detail.title: PROJECT REPORT ON PLANNING AND MANAGEMENT OF BIRGUNJ GREEN DRIVE: URBAN PLANTATION PROJECT ALONG THE BIRGUNJ ROAD

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This research has not been sponsored or founded by any organization or agency. This is an independent research.
